# Generated by gen_p11.py - do not edit by hand.
source React 19.3.1 (react-dom 19.3.1) on jsdom 30.1.3, run by tools/oracle with the harness catalog; orders pinned in _source/react-observed.md
seed 1
compare records dump=n node=depth,label,tag,props text=depth,value
requirement R1 An effect runs once per mount, and only after the render that created it has been committed
requirement R2 An effect with an empty deps array runs once: re-renders, new props and clicks elsewhere do not run it again
requirement R3 With a deps array the effect runs again only when a dependency changed, and its previous cleanup runs first
requirement R4 An effect without a deps array runs after every render, cleanup first
requirement R5 When a component is removed its cleanup runs, also for components nested in it: a parent's before its children's
requirement R6 On mount, effects run children before parents and siblings in order
requirement R7 In one commit every cleanup runs before any effect
requirement R8 An effect and its cleanup keep the closure of the render that ran them
requirement E2E Long sessions that mix all of the above
case 11-R1-nothing-runs-before-the-commit R1
title two Loggers in a div: after 4 units of work no effect has run, after the flush both have
input
tree t <div><Logger name=a/><Logger name=b/></div>
render t
idle 4
log
dump
flush
log
dump
expected
idle 4
dump 1
log mount a
log mount b
dump 2
node 0 a div ""
node 1 b em ""
text 2 "a"
node 1 c em ""
text 2 "b"
end
